PARA_CADA.DESCRICAO_DICA: Say what each item of the list is, for example: each new employee in the HR list.
PARA_CADA.CAMPO_DICA: What the AI takes from each item. It fills in only what is written in the conversation. "nome" is always there: the contact and the card are created from it.
PARA_CADA.SEM_TELEFONE: Without the WhatsApp of each one, every item becomes a new contact with the name only, even if the person is already in your contacts.
PARA_CADA.MAXIMO_DICA: From 1 to {maximo}. Items beyond this do not become cards, and the history says how many were left out.
PARA_CADA.MAXIMO_FORA: Choose a whole number from 1 to {maximo}.
PARA_CADA.CONTATO_DICA: Each item uses the contact with the same WhatsApp, or a new contact is created, as in Import contacts. An existing contact only gets what it lacks: a filled-in name or phone is never replaced. It goes to the company of whoever sent the list, unless it already has another company.
PARA_CADA.FRASE: For each item of the list ({item}): create a card
PARA_CADA.FRASE_SEM_ITEM: For each item of a list: create a card
PARA_CADA.VALOR_QUANTOS: How many items the list had
